text:
```yaml
name: Community PR Permissions Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black flake8

      - name: Run linting
        run: |
          black --check .
          flake8 .

      - name: Check for changes in sensitive files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          files: |
            docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat.md
            docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat-migrations.md
            airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml
            airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/metadata.yaml

      - name: Fail if sensitive files are modified
        if: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files != '' }}
        run: echo "Sensitive files have been modified. Please ensure these changes are intentional." && exit 1

      - name: Request additional permissions if needed
        if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'community-member' }}
        run: echo "This PR requires additional permissions from the maintainers due to changes in sensitive files."
```
